summary: Strive, Inc. (Nasdaq: ASST) filed a routine 8-K on October 13, 2026, announcing a proposed registered initial public offering of 5,000,000 shares of its 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock at a $100 stated amount per share. Net proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, including bitcoin acquisitions, income-generating assets, capital expenditures, and potential buybacks of Class A common or SATA preferred stock, or complementary acquisitions. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The offering remains subject to market and other conditions, typical of a shelf takedown rather than a special situation; no deal terms, pricing, or closing date are stated.
